meta.summary: Strict AI spend policy for a 501-2000 headcount manufacturer experimenting with AI, envelopes set at 1.8x sector median with CFO approval required for frontier exceptions.

shadow_ai.reimbursement_rule: AI tool purchases on personal or employee cards are not reimbursable; all AI subscriptions must be procured through the approved vendor catalog via Finance.

response_ladder.trigger: Team envelope reaches 72% of monthly budget before day 20
Team envelope reaches 90% of monthly budget or spend rate projects overage within 5 days
Company envelope reaches 95% of monthly budget or any team exceeds envelope by more than 10%

rationales.e1: Production inference for the support-triage service at $211/day ($6,330/month) falls within the Engineering envelope of $6,500 and is correctly routed to an allowlisted primary provider under the efficient default tier.
rationales.e2: Nightly embeddings job at $38/day ($1,140/month) is attributed to the Data team, within the $2,500 Data envelope, and qualifies as a routine batch workload requiring no escalation.
rationales.e3: A 96% cost-per-request increase with flat volume indicates a model version or prompt-size regression in the deploy; this breaches the 20% variance band on the Engineering envelope and triggers a step-1 alert to the team lead for root-cause review within 4 hours.
rationales.e4: This is the third ChatGPT Team subscription on the Marketing card this quarter, exceeding the team_subscription_threshold of 1 duplicate; the charge is rerouted to the approved vendor catalog and the employee card transaction is blocked per shadow AI policy.
rationales.e5: The $4,800 fine-tune request from ML Platform exceeds the $1,000 approval threshold; it is routed for CFO sign-off before the job is queued, and the standard ML procurement checklist must be completed.
rationales.e6: The autonomous research agent reached 340 retries per hour, exceeding the 10-retry-per-task limit, and context grew each cycle beyond the 15% per-loop cap; the agent was killed before it reached the $20/hr kill threshold, preventing an estimated $1,090 in uncontrolled burn.
rationales.e7: The Growth team frontier-model exception for the demo build is within the 24-hour approval window and the $100 delta cap; the request is forwarded to the CFO for same-day approval before any frontier spend is incurred.
rationales.e8: A 22x baseline spike on an unattributed personal API key triggers ladder step 2 throttle; the Engineering lead is notified within 2 hours to attribute the project tag and confirm the work is sanctioned before spend resumes.
rationales.e9: Agent card charge of 499 against a 250 ceiling. Approval required.
rationales.e10: The Design team's $89/month AI video trial duplicates a $1,400/year Sales contract at 40% seat utilization; consolidating onto the existing contract recovers $840 in annualized unused seat value and the trial subscription is rerouted to that contract.
rationales.e11: Unrecognized provider under a block new-provider rule. Blocked, owner paged.
rationales.e12: Inference tagged to an internal tool is reclassified from COGS to OpEx per the project_tag rule matching 'internal-tool'; the corrected classification is applied retroactively to the current month's ledger.
rationales.e13: Month-to-date spend at 87% of the company envelope with 9 days remaining exceeds the 72% burn_alert_pct trigger; the CFO and Engineering lead are notified and non-critical workloads are throttled to prevent envelope breach before month close.
rationales.e14: Weekly rollup is complete; all team envelopes, classification rules, and agent guardrails are within policy parameters and no open exceptions remain pending beyond the active CFO approval queue.
